name: Todoist
description: Todoist is a task and project management app that lets individuals and teams capture, organize, schedule, and track to-do items, with support for natural-language input, recurring tasks, labels, calendar views, and shared team workspaces.
best_for: Positioned for individuals, freelancers, and agile teams who want fast, cross-platform task capture with natural language parsing, clean interface views, and minimal project management friction.
features: Natural-language quick task entry with automated date, priority, and label parsing
Recurring due dates and custom reminder alerts
Multiple layout views: list, board (Kanban), and interactive calendar
Projects, sections, sub-tasks, priority flags, and custom filter views
Shared team workspaces with role-based member assignments and comments
Built-in AI Task Assist for breaking complex projects into actionable steps

tiers.name: Beginner
tiers.notes: Free plan. Includes up to 5 active personal projects, 3 filter views, list/board layouts, and 1-week activity history.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Billed at $5/month annually ($60/year) or $7/month monthly. 7-day free trial. Includes 300 active personal projects, 150 filter views, calendar layout, custom task reminders, full activity history, and AI Task Assist.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Billed at $8/user/month annually ($96/user/year) or $10/user/month monthly. 14-day free trial. Includes shared team workspace, 500 team projects, team activity logs, role permissions, and centralized billing.

pros: Fast natural language parsing for instant task creation and scheduling
Robust cross-platform native apps with instant syncing across desktop, mobile, and browser extensions
Generous Pro tier capacity (300 projects, 150 filters) with flexible list, Kanban board, and calendar views
cons: Free plan is limited to 5 active projects and excludes calendar view and custom reminders
Lacks built-in time tracking or extensive document/wiki capabilities compared to all-in-one workspaces

faq.question: Is Todoist free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Todoist offers a permanent free Beginner plan supporting up to 5 active projects, 3 filter views, and basic task management across all supported platforms.

faq.question: How much does Todoist Pro cost?
faq.answer: Todoist Pro costs $5 per month billed annually ($60/year) or $7 per month billed monthly, unlocking 300 projects, calendar layout, reminders, and AI Task Assist.

faq.question: Does Todoist offer a team plan?
faq.answer: Yes, Todoist Business costs $8 per user/month billed annually ($10/user/month monthly) and includes a shared team workspace, 500 team projects, admin controls, and centralized billing.
